name: seteuid
description: seteuid() sets the effective user ID of the calling process. Unprivileged processes can only set it to the real user ID, effective user ID, or saved set-user-ID. The same rules apply to setegid() for group IDs.

parameters.name: euid
parameters.description: The new effective user ID to set

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The target user ID is not valid in this user namespace.
The calling process is not privileged and euid does not match the current real user ID, effective user ID, or saved set-user-ID.

versions: Linux 1.1.37 and later; glibc variations (e.g., glibc 2.0 equivalent to setreuid, glibc 2.1 and later equivalent to setresuid)
